description: A mature human microRNA, the approximately 22-nucleotide strand that regulates target mRNAs. Precursor microRNA genes are represented separately as Gene nodes and linked through ENCODES_GeM relationships. Mature sequences are not stored.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: miRBase mature microRNA accession in the form mirbase.mature:MIMAT followed by seven digits, for example mirbase.mature:MIMAT0000076.

common_properties.name: name
common_properties.description: The miRDB mature microRNA name, for example hsa-miR-21-5p.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing to the microRNA node; miRDB supplies this population.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Date and time when the node or its properties were last created or changed.

source_contributions.scope: Mature human microRNAs appearing in miRDB v6.0 target predictions, with names beginning hsa- and a resolved miRBase mature accession. No prediction-score threshold is applied.
source_contributions.description: MicroRNAs retain their identity even when their predicted target genes or precursor genes have no corresponding Gene node in SPOKE.
